block-world.title: Play Block World Online for Free - Construction Game Fun
block-world.description: Dive into Block World, a captivating construction game inspired by Minecraft. Explore endless possibilities and build your dream world. Play Block World now and unleash your creativity! Enjoy Block World game for free today.

HomeIframe.title: Block World
HomeIframe.description: Explore the limitless possibilities of Block World, a construction game in the style of Minecraft.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Block World is a construction game similar to Minecraft style. This is a free game, you are completely free to imagine without any constraints.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: WASD or arrow keys to move
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Left-click to remove a block, Right-click to place a block
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Space bar to jump, 1 to 9 numbers to choose a block
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Extremely easy construction and control mechanism in Block World.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: You can choose from 2 game modes: life or freedom in Block World.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: It plays out like real life, day and night. Very authentic!
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: The night will have a flashlight to assist you. T uses the torch. F to use a flashlight.
